analysis: CIVO Detector ve_ratio threshold sensitivity analysis
motivation: Seed=3 has ve_ratio=0.497 at 45K (NVE=1.50x), missing threshold by 0.003. All other 3 conditions met at that step.

exp_008f.verdict: SAFE - peak below 0.49, still blocked by condition 1

exp_001_baseline.note: Already above 0.5 at 65K. At that point: ve_ratio=0.563, delta_ve=0.159, accelerating=true, BUT eval_decline=false. Lowering to 0.49 doesn't change anything.
exp_001_baseline.verdict: SAFE - already above old threshold, blocked by condition 4 (no eval decline)

exp_020_vanilla.note: At 85K: ve_ratio=0.548, delta_ve=0.133, but delta_ve_prev=0.095<0.1 so consecutive condition fails. At 75K: ve_ratio=0.415<0.49. No point between 0.49-0.50.
exp_020_vanilla.verdict: SAFE - no time point with 0.49<ve_ratio<0.50, existing blocks still hold

exp_008d_seed0.note: Already triggers at 0.5 threshold (ve_ratio=0.693@45K). No change.

exp_010b_cheetah.note: Already triggers at 0.5 threshold (ve_ratio=3.18@65K). No change.

exp_008d_seed3.note: ve_ratio=0.497@45K. With 0.49 threshold: 4/4 conditions met → triggers. Lead time = 60K steps (decline at 105K).

exp_009b_self_correcting.note: Peak ve_ratio=0.570@55K already above 0.5. Blocked by delta_ve=0.034<0.1 at 55K. At 45K: ve_ratio=0.536>0.49 with delta_ve=0.237 and accelerating, BUT eval_decline=false (164→141→164, middle point lower but t-2=141.12<t-1=164.14 so no monotonic decline). No change.
exp_009b_self_correcting.verdict: NO CHANGE - still correctly not triggered

exp_008e_v3_s2_pathway_b.note: Still triggers reactively at 105K (after collapse@95K). No change to timing.

summary.recommendation: Adopt 0.49 threshold. Rationale: (1) 0.003 gap is numerical noise, not meaningful signal separation. (2) Margin to nearest TN peak (008f@0.454) is 0.036, providing comfortable buffer. (3) Mean lead time improves from 10K to 26.7K steps. (4) No FPR degradation on any test case.
